observations.body: Jesus joins love and commandments to another Counselor, not leaving disciples orphaned, mutual dwelling, remembered teaching, peace, the ruler’s approach, and the command to arise and leave.
observations.label: Another Counselor, peace, love, teaching, and departure are promised

observations.body: The passage presents Loving, keeping, coming, teaching, remembering, and leaving as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Loving, keeping, coming, teaching, remembering, and leaving

observations.body: The passage places Presence, teaching, remembrance, and peace beside Loving, keeping, coming, teaching, remembering, and leaving.
observations.label: Presence, teaching, remembrance, and peace

payload.posture: Read John 14:15–31 as one movement in the Last Supper, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states jesus joins love and commandments to another Counselor, not leaving disciples orphaned, mutual dwelling, remembered teaching, peace, the ruler’s approach, and the command to arise and leave. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Last Supper.
payload.title: Another Counselor, peace, love, teaching, and departure are promised
